name: most
description: Most — мост ПК ↔ VPS для входящих сообщений мессенджеров (Telegram, MAX, VK, Avito, Instagram, WhatsApp)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @most/shared && npm run build -w @most/server && npm run build -w @most/agent
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build -w @most/dashboard
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 scripts/verify-structure.test.mjs packages/shared/src/test/shared.test.ts packages/server/src/test/integration.test.ts && node --import tsx scripts/smoke-ingest.mjs && node --import tsx scripts/smoke-sequence.mjs
